round13_wallpaper_blind.replicate_search: no Siax, no UltraSharpV2, no Remacri on Replicate — it hosts vanilla Real-ESRGAN and the SDXL upscalers, not the OpenModelDB community finetunes. Putting Siax there means pushing a private Cog model, billed for total online time including idle (T4 $0.000225/s = ~$583/mo always-on), not per call.
round13_wallpaper_blind.gpu_box_math: cheapest dedicated GPU box is Hetzner GEX from EUR 184/mo (RTX 4000 Ada); marketplace hourly from ~$0.50/h. The server-wide rate gate is 50 calls/day, so the paid Topaz route costs at most 50 x 30 x $0.05 = $75/mo at full saturation every day — less than half the cheapest box. The gate caps spend below the box price by construction.

modal_measured.setup: Modal, T4, onnxruntime-gpu 1.20.2 on nvidia/cuda:12.4.1-cudnn9, Siax baked into the image, scaledown_window 10s
modal_measured.provider_confirmed: CUDAExecutionProvider — not a silent CPU fallback
modal_measured.cold_start: 26.8s and 26.7s wall on two independent cold containers; ~13s of that is container start + model load
modal_measured.warm: 11.3s inference for 1200x800 (24 tiles); 13.8s for 828x1023 (30 tiles); 36.1s for 1366x2048 (77 tiles)
modal_measured.unit: ~0.47 s per 232x232 tile, flat across all three sizes — cost is per tile, not per megapixel
modal_measured.big_picture: 1366x2048 -> 5464x8192 (44.8 Mp) finished cleanly in 36.1s. This is the picture that killed the browser tab twice, at tile 192 and at tile 128. Confirms the crash was the integrated Arc's shared memory, not the model.
modal_measured.cost_measured: $0.0044 per picture including full cold start; 50/day all-cold = $6.58/month against Topaz's $75 ceiling
modal_measured.vs_topaz: Topaz x4 took 13.4s on Replicate; warm Siax takes 11.3s. Same speed, and Siax is the one he preferred.
modal_measured.port_check: the Python tiling matches the JS .modelbake.mjs pixel for pixel — mean difference 0.001/255 once both are encoded as the same jpeg
modal_measured.estimate_was: $0.006/picture, ~20s cold start — both a little pessimistic but the right shape
